svg.title: Estro core system and component contract
svg.desc: A dark design-system board documenting Estro's colors, typography, density, icon language, editor shell measurements, responsive behavior, reusable controls, focus, loading, motion, and progressive disclosure.
svg.text: The smallest shared visual and interaction foundation Phase 1 and Phase 2 may implement.
Neutral surfaces frame the media; color names state or action.
Body explains the result in plain language.
System UI · 400 / 500 / 600 · technical values use tabular numerals
Explanations cap near 60–75 characters; mobile inputs stay ≥16px.
Panels collapse before the canvas or program monitor becomes unusable.
Center stage remains the largest usable region
Photo filmstrip: 120px only when multi-asset context exists
Complete editor: 1180×700 minimum · 1280×720 recommended · 200% zoom and 320px reflow for supported flows
UI and WebMCP expose the same target, validation, revision, and Undo.
One filled primary action per local task · pointer press 0.96 · keyboard is immediate
Visible label · units · keyboard increments · reset · min/max/default in semantics
Active overrides, validation, consequences, and agent changes never stay hidden.

g.text: static cues remain · no spectral travel

svg.text: Implementation must verify OKLCH gamut, APCA, keyboard traversal, 200% zoom, screen-reader announcements, and the final browser matrix.
No framework or dependency selected by this contract
